intro: Between 2026-04-13 and 2026-09-11, ZCyberNews published 31 articles tagged privilege-escalation. The coverage spans five critical, 22 high, and three medium severity items, with Chaotic Eclipse and Lazarus Group among the top threat actors observed. Prominent vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-8950, CVE-2026-8956, and CVE-2026-8957, each rated CVSS 9.8, alongside CVE-2026-34659 and CVE-2026-34660 at CVSS 9.6. Affected sectors include technology, enterprise, government, healthcare, and education. The reporting reaches readers across Global, Brazil, France, Germany, and India.
